courses.overview: 從「晶圓對晶圓混合接合」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.why: 把「晶圓對晶圓混合接合」與「背面供電網路製程」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding with Backside power-delivery processing: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transfer: 晶圓接合可以為背面加工提供支撐，也可以形成垂直互連；必須先分清接合的用途。
related.transferEn: Wafer bonding can support backside processing or form vertical interconnects; its purpose must be defined first.
related.difference: 背面供電重整電源路徑；混合接合連接兩個器件或晶圓界面，並非每一個支撐接合都含金屬互連。
related.differenceEn: Backside power reorganizes power routing; hybrid bonding connects device or wafer interfaces, and not every support bond contains metal interconnects.
practice: 分別畫出支撐接合與電性接合
標示正面與背面的電流路徑
列出移除支撐前必須保留的結構
practiceEn: Draw support bonding and electrical bonding separately
Mark frontside and backside current paths
List structures that must remain before a carrier is removed

related.transfer: 縮小互連節距可提高接點密度；縮短垂直連線有助降低互連電阻與損失，但仍需共同評估接合、散熱、測試與良率。
related.transferEn: Finer interconnect pitch increases connection density; shorter vertical connections can reduce interconnect resistance and loss, while bonding, heat removal, testing and yield still need joint assessment.

courses.summary:
晶圓接合的進步需要材料、對位與設備工程一起發展。EV Group 在奧地利的總部提供一個理解精密設備供應如何支援半導體整合的代表地點。

公司於 1980 年成立，並於 1999 年推出面對面晶圓對位技術 SmartView。歷史強調的是介面可被對準、量測及重複處理的重要性；本課程不將某一公司的設備史當成所有混合接合的唯一來源。座標為城鎮代表點，官方地址供地圖查詢，未聲稱廠区開放參觀。
courses.summaryEn:
Progress in wafer bonding combines materials, alignment and equipment engineering. EV Group’s Austrian headquarters is a representative setting for understanding how precision-equipment suppliers support semiconductor integration.

The company was founded in 1980 and introduced SmartView face-to-face wafer alignment in 1999. The history emphasizes interfaces that can be aligned, measured and processed repeatably; it does not make one supplier the sole origin of hybrid bonding. Coordinates represent the town and the official address supports map lookup, without implying public factory access.
